title: SSE stream dual-buffer: raw_buf and buf each cap at 1 MiB; combined peak is ~2 MiB
description: raw_buf and buf are each checked independently against SSE_BUF_SIZE_LIMIT (1 MiB). Both can approach 1 MiB simultaneously: raw_buf accumulates incoming bytes before UTF-8 decode; buf holds decoded text. Peak live memory per SSE stream is ~2 MiB, not ~1 MiB as the constant name implies. At scale with many concurrent SSE connections this doubles the expected per-connection memory budget. The comment 'Use the same limit' is technically correct (same constant) but the combined budget is undocumented.
